messages:
Priya Patel: Quick Q — thinking about adding a per-route KPIs card to Console that surfaces p50/p95/p99 token latency, throughput (req/s, tok/s), error rate, and KV cache hit rate. Want to show kernel attribution when p99 spikes. Any concerns?

Alex Cohen: +1. Need to be careful about sampling. Full token-level breakdown can be heavy. We should sample traces and show a waterfall for selected samples.

Marta Lopez: Agree. Maybe default to aggregated p50/p95/p99 and provide "Inspect sample" that opens a detailed token-waterfall for a single trace. KV hit rate attributed per-route sounds useful — but we need normalized denominator (requests vs tokens).

TJ Nguyen: Implementation note: telemetry events already include kernel_choice and kv_* metrics, but they're coarse-grained. We need new metrics: token_latency_ms_per_stage (decode, kv_lookup, attention, kernel_exec). Sending at 1/100 sample might be ok.

Priya Patel: Can we add a flag to route config to enable token-level traces? UI toggle + storage TTL? Want this opt-in for Dedicated/Private.

Alex Cohen: UI idea: compact KPI card with sparkline for p95 and tappable "breakdown" that shows stacked bar of stages and a small table (p50/p95/p99, throughput, kv_hit). Mock:

[code]
KPIs:
- p50: 45ms   p95: 210ms   p99: 420ms
- Throughput: 150 req/s (12k tok/s)
- Error rate: 0.3%
- KV hit: 62%
[END code]

Marta Lopez: Also surface "kernel switch events" when we fallback to a cheaper quantized kernel. That should be a separate event list with timestamps.

console-bot: deploy/metrics-collector 03:12 — New telemetry flag "route.token_trace_sampling" set to 1/100 for staging.

Priya Patel: UX question — should p99 be a 1-minute window or 5-minute? Ops tends to use 5m for alerts, product wants 1m for spike detection.

TJ Nguyen: Ops preference: p99 on 5m for alerting, but dashboard can show multi-agg controls (1m/5m/1h). We'll add time window selector.

Alex Cohen: Backend: add an ingest pipeline to compute per-route rolling quantiles and kv hit ratio. Might need a local aggregator at the runtime to emit pre-aggregated histograms to reduce cardinality.

Marta Lopez: On the display, color-code p99 if delta > baseline by X% and show "attribution" pill listing top contributors: KV misses, kernel_exec, decoding.

Priya Patel: Action items:
- TJ: propose telemetry fields and sampling config (this week)
- Alex: prototype KPI card mock in Figma + minimal API schema for dashboard (next sprint)
- Marta: propose attribution UI and wording (this week)
- Console team: mark this opt-in for Private until storage/retention discussed.

TJ Nguyen: I'll post a minimal schema snippet here:

[code]
route_kpi_event {
  route_id: string
  window_secs: int
  p50_ms: int
  p95_ms: int
  p99_ms: int
  tok_per_sec: int
  req_per_sec: int
  error_count: int
  kv_hits: int
  kv_lookups: int
  kernel_choice_counts: map[string]int
  sample_traces: [trace_id]
}
[END code]

Alex Cohen: For kernel_choice_counts we should map to kernel_id + quantization level. Also add "prefetch_hit_rate" if we enable prefetch cache.

Marta Lopez: Cool. One more ask: include "sample trace" links that when clicked open the token-waterfall with markers for kernel boundary and KV lookup timings.

Priya Patel: Great — sounds actionable. Let's sync Friday 11am to review Figma + telemetry PR. Thanks team :clap:

Alex Cohen: +1 :thumbsup:

console-bot: meeting scheduled — Friday 11:00 (calendar invite sent).
